articles.title: Home Loan Eligibility Criteria
articles.content: LICHFL determines home loan eligibility based on your income, repayment capacity, age, co-applicant's income (if any), assets & liabilities, savings history, and stability & continuity of occupation. Salaried individuals with stable employment and self-employed individuals with documented income are both eligible. Joint applications with spouse, parents, or siblings can increase eligibility.

articles.title: Documents Required for Home Loan Application
articles.content: The key documents required for a housing loan application include: Proof of identity (Aadhaar card, Passport, etc.), Proof of income (salary slips, IT returns, Form 16 for salaried; bank statements for self-employed), Proof of address (Aadhaar card, Passport, etc.), and Property-related documents (sale agreement, title deed, RERA registration certificate for under-construction properties).

articles.title: Home Loan Interest Rates and Processing Fees
articles.content: LICHFL offers competitive home loan interest rates starting from 8.50% per annum. Rates vary based on loan amount, tenure, and borrower profile. For the latest rate of interest and processing fees, please check https://www.lichousing.com/comprehensive-notice-board. Both fixed and floating rate options are available.

articles.title: EMI Calculation for Home Loans
articles.content: Your EMI (Equated Monthly Installment) is calculated based on three factors: the loan amount, the interest rate, and the repayment tenure. A higher loan amount or interest rate increases EMI, while a longer tenure reduces it. You can use the EMI Calculator on the LICHFL website (lichousing.com) for an estimate.

articles.title: Loan Repayment Tenure
articles.content: The repayment tenure for LICHFL home loans ranges from 5 to 30 years, depending on the home loan scheme, your eligibility, and your preference. Longer tenures result in lower EMIs but higher total interest paid. Shorter tenures mean higher EMIs but less total interest.

articles.title: Security / Collateral for Home Loans
articles.content: The property you purchase with the home loan typically serves as the primary security or collateral for the loan. This means the property is mortgaged to LICHFL until the loan is fully repaid.

articles.title: Prepayment of Home Loans
articles.content: You can prepay your outstanding housing loan amount (in part or in full) before the scheduled loan tenure is complete. There are no prepayment charges on floating rate home loans unless the loan is availed for business purposes. Prepayment helps reduce total interest paid and shortens the loan tenure.

articles.title: Fixed Rate vs Floating Rate of Interest
articles.content: Under a fixed rate of interest, the rate remains constant for the entire tenure of the loan. Under a floating rate, the interest rate is linked with the Prime Lending Rate (PLR) of the company and can vary during the loan depending on changes in the PLR. Most borrowers in India opt for floating rates as they tend to be lower initially.

articles.title: Joint Borrowers for Home Loans
articles.content: Immediate family members (close blood relatives) such as your parents, spouse, children, and brother/sister are allowed to be joint borrowers for a home loan. Joint applications can significantly increase your loan eligibility, especially when the co-applicant is an earning member.

articles.title: Loan Disbursement Process
articles.content: The loan amount can be disbursed in one single payment if the property is already completed (ready-to-move). For under-construction properties, the loan is often disbursed in stages as construction progresses, with each stage representing an installment linked to the builder's construction milestones.

articles.title: Home Loans for Post-Retirement Applicants
articles.content: You can apply for a home loan post-retirement until the attainment of 65 years of age, provided you are receiving a pension under the Defined Benefit Pension Scheme (DBPS). Pension income is considered for eligibility assessment.

articles.title: Home Loans for Self-Employed Without ITR
articles.content: A self-employed individual can apply for a home loan without an income tax return document. In such cases, loan eligibility will be evaluated based on the 2-year bank statement showing regular income credits.

articles.title: Loans for Commercial Property
articles.content: LICHFL provides loans for the purchase, construction, extension, or repair of commercial property where the usage is limited to shops, showrooms, office premises, OPD clinics, or diagnostic centers only.

articles.title: Tax Benefits on Home Loans
articles.content: Housing loans are eligible for tax benefits under Sections 80C (principal repayment up to ₹1.5 lakh), 24(b) (interest deduction up to ₹2 lakh for self-occupied property), and 80EEA of the Income Tax Act, 1961. Since benefits may vary each year, please consult your income tax expert or chartered accountant for the latest information.

articles.title: Modes of Loan Repayment
articles.content: Loan repayments can be made through E-NACH (Electronic National Automated Clearing House) or NACH. This ensures automatic monthly deduction of EMI from your bank account, providing convenience and avoiding missed payments.

articles.title: Why Choose LIC Housing Finance
articles.content: LIC Housing Finance offers: 65+ years of LIC brand trust, competitive interest rates starting from 8.50%, doorstep document pickup and verification service, dedicated area office teams across India, smooth processing for RERA-registered under-construction projects, and flexible repayment tenures from 5 to 30 years. Toll-free helpline: 1800 209 1989.

articles.title: Customer Portal and Certificates
articles.content: Existing customers can log in to the customer portal at https://customer.lichousing.com/login.php to download their interest certificate or repayment schedule. The portal also provides access to account statements and other loan-related documents.
